## Background

Adapts NVIDIA GR00T to OARbot: map the robot's observation and action
spaces into GR00T's embodiment interface, fine-tune on the
[B2](../../../platform-data/epics/B2-demonstration-dataset/README.qmd)
dataset, and iterate on the data mix and training budget until the
policy performs on the real robot. Each training run is recorded as an
experiment under this epic with its dataset version, config, and
rollout videos. Compared head-to-head against the HF baselines in C2
during the C3 evaluation.
